items.prompt: A delivery company has lost your parcel for the third time. You reply to their email. Which reply fits best?
options: Third time now. Could you refund me when you get a chance?
Third time. This is a disgrace, and I want my money back now.
items.target: Third time. This is a disgrace, and I want my money back now.

items.prompt: Your housemate ate the dinner you'd saved for yourself. Which reply fits best?
options: You ate the dinner I'd saved. I'll make something else, then.
You ate the dinner I'd saved? Unbelievable. Don't touch my things.
items.target: You ate the dinner I'd saved? Unbelievable. Don't touch my things.

items.prompt: A colleague takes credit for your work in a meeting. Afterwards, which reply fits best?
options: That was my analysis, and you know it. Don't ever do that again.
That was my analysis. Honestly, I just feel invisible in this team.
items.target: That was my analysis, and you know it. Don't ever do that again.

items.prompt: The landlord says the heating won't be fixed until next month. Which reply fits best?
options: Next month? That's a disgrace. Fix it this week or I call the council.
Next month? What if the kids get ill in the cold until then?
items.target: Next month? That's a disgrace. Fix it this week or I call the council.

items.prompt: A driver cuts in front of you and nearly causes a crash. Your passenger asks if you're all right. Which reply fits best?
options: No, my hands are shaking. That was so close.
No! That idiot nearly killed us. I could scream.
items.target: No! That idiot nearly killed us. I could scream.

items.prompt: Your teenager comes home at two in the morning without calling. Which reply fits best?
options: Two in the morning! Not one call! You're grounded for a month.
You're home, thank goodness. Come here, I was up all night.
items.target: Two in the morning! Not one call! You're grounded for a month.

items.prompt: The council has cut down the old tree on your street without notice. A neighbour asks what you think. Which reply fits best?
options: It's a scandal. They didn't ask any of us. I'm writing to them.
It breaks my heart. That tree was here before any of us.
items.target: It's a scandal. They didn't ask any of us. I'm writing to them.

items.prompt: Your friend cancels on you for the fourth time, an hour before. Which reply fits best?
options: Again? An hour before? I'm done rearranging my life around you.
No problem, these things happen. Let's find another day soon.
items.target: Again? An hour before? I'm done rearranging my life around you.

items.prompt: A shop refuses to refund a faulty kettle. Which reply fits best?
options: It broke in a week. This is ridiculous, get me the manager.
It broke in a week. Could I speak to the manager, please?
items.target: It broke in a week. This is ridiculous, get me the manager.

items.prompt: Your brother borrowed your car and returned it with a dent. Which reply fits best?
options: You dented my car and said nothing? Are you serious?
There's a dent in the car. We'll need to get it fixed.
items.target: You dented my car and said nothing? Are you serious?

items.prompt: A coworker keeps interrupting you in meetings. Afterwards, which reply fits best?
options: Could you let me finish next time? Thanks, it would help.
Stop cutting me off. It's rude, and I won't put up with it.
items.target: Stop cutting me off. It's rude, and I won't put up with it.

items.prompt: Your gym has charged you twice for the same month. Which reply fits best?
options: I've been charged twice this month. Please refund one of the payments.
You've charged me twice this month. Refund it today or I'm cancelling.
items.target: You've charged me twice this month. Refund it today or I'm cancelling.

items.prompt: A friend asks how parents' evening went. The teacher blamed your son for a fight he didn't start. Which reply fits best?
options: Terrible. She blamed him for a fight he didn't start. He cried all the way home.
Terrible. She blamed him for a fight he didn't start. I was shaking with rage.
items.target: Terrible. She blamed him for a fight he didn't start. I was shaking with rage.

items.prompt: The neighbours' builders have blocked your driveway again. Which reply fits best?
options: Move that van now. This is the third time this week.
Morning! Could you move the van when you get a moment?
items.target: Move that van now. This is the third time this week.

items.prompt: Your partner forgot your birthday. Which reply fits best?
options: You forgot. I just wanted one day to feel special.
You forgot. Again. Don't even bother with an excuse.
items.target: You forgot. Again. Don't even bother with an excuse.

items.prompt: An online seller sent the wrong size and wants you to pay return postage. Which reply fits best?
options: You sent the wrong size. Please send a free return label.
Your mistake, and I pay? Absolutely not. Send a free label now.
items.target: Your mistake, and I pay? Absolutely not. Send a free label now.
